name: Airport Terminal Fresh Ripe Yellow Banana
whyItWorks: Nature's portable gastrointestinal medicine. The thick protective peel keeps it sanitary in airports. Rich in soluble pectin and potassium to prevent travel cramping and dehydration.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick a fully yellow banana with light brown speckles (avoid green unripe bananas with resistant starch). Available at Starbucks counter or fruit baskets.
